title: H1.24 task-level stability replication
objective: Replicate the frozen H1.23 BASE-30 eight-task panel with new rollout seeds to test whether its task-level positive clustering persists.
scientific_question: Under the frozen base agent and interface, does the H1.23 task-level reward clustering persist across independent rollout seeds?
hypothesis: The H1.23 nonzero cluster may be task-specific and should either persist on the same task identities or disappear under new rollout seeds; this cannot establish family causality or learning efficacy.
claim_boundary: This group is BASE-30 only, has no training, memory, adapter, teacher, retrieval, or outcome-conditioned selection, and cannot open Q3, H2, D0, retention, transfer, or SEED.

contamination_check.note: This is an explicit new-seed replication of the frozen H1.23 panel, not a new-task efficacy test.

next_gate: Run exactly one 32-attempt new-seed BASE-30 replication after the 8-UUID gate; then reconcile and close the descriptive branch.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after online initialization/upload failure with exact error and spool hash

hard_boundaries: Do not change the frozen eight task identities, prompt, parser, horizon, family definitions, denominator, or validity rule after launch.
Change only rollout seeds relative to H1.23; do not use training, teacher assistance, adapters, memory, retrieval, or evaluation outcomes.
Do not disturb external workloads; an occupied UUID blocks that cell.
Keep W&B online by default and preserve any explicit offline error and spool hash.
stop_rule: Stop after one 32-attempt BASE-30 replication; no training or follow-up sweep.
positive_branch: If task 6262 or the womens_fashion cluster persists, report task-level stability only; Q3 remains closed.
negative_branch: If the positive cluster disappears, classify H1.23 as task-specific/stochastic; do not generalize.
scientific_role: exploratory task-level stability replication; descriptive only

next_branch_rule.qualified_positive_cluster_persists: remain descriptive; no Q3 opening; require independent task identities before any efficacy test
next_branch_rule.qualified_positive_cluster_disappears: classify H1.23 as task-specific/stochastic and do not generalize
next_branch_rule.invalid_or_runtime_failure: exclude from denominator and repair only the operational contract
